description: Empower your Zambian enterprise with autonomous AI agents. Run 24/7 cloud workflows, browser research, and Telegram operations effortlessly.
h1: Run Autonomous AI Agents Across Zambia
sub: Deploy persistent AI bots that research markets, automate workflows, and code systems round-the-clock inside an isolated cloud computer.
audience: Copperbelt mining suppliers, Lusaka commercial enterprises, Mkushi commercial farmers, fintech developers, and regional logistics operators.
manifesto: Zambian commerce demands constant responsiveness across fluctuating supply chains and borders. Ceyo provides persistent cloud intelligence that never sleeps, keeping your enterprise coordinated, automated, and ahead around the clock even when your phone disconnects.

uses.d: Track equipment pricing, tender portals, and supplier availability across Kitwe and Ndola automatically using autonomous browser scraping.
Monitor regional maize, soybean, and fertilizer price shifts across Mkushi and central hubs, compiling scheduled daily summaries directly to Google Sheets.
Coordinate clearance status and transit updates along the Chirundu and Kasumbalesa transport corridors through continuous Telegram alerts.
Deploy specialized Telegram agents to handle client quotations, product inquiries, and order confirmations for Lusaka retail and distribution firms.
Let dedicated coding agents write, debug, and test API integrations and web applications inside their own cloud environment.
Extract statutory updates, trade notices, and tax documentation into comprehensive research reports delivered straight to your inbox.

steps.d: Select your specialized AI agent and spin up an isolated 24/7 cloud computer instantly.
Link Telegram, Gmail, Notion, Google Sheets, and over 1,000 everyday business platforms.
Schedule recurring browser jobs, multi-agent group chats, and coding routines that run without interruption.

chapters.d: While Lusaka wakes up, your agent scans commodity rates, parses exchange sheets, and delivers a consolidated market brief directly to your private Telegram channel.
Your autonomous browser checks transit manifests and regulatory portals along key regional trade routes, flagging border clearance delays to your operations group.
Your coding agent writes and runs scripts inside its isolated cloud machine, connecting client databases with internal tracking spreadsheets without manual code review.
Even after you disconnect your mobile device, your bot team processes international inquiries, updates inventory records, and prepares tomorrow's schedule.

highlights: Telegram bot teams and voice calls

faq.q: How much does Ceyo cost and is there a trial?
faq.a: Ceyo offers three subscription tiers: Plus ($20/month), Pro ($60/month), and Ultra ($120/month). Every plan includes a 3-day free trial with up to 1,000,000 tokens per day; your linked payment card is only billed after the trial ends unless cancelled.

faq.q: Do Ceyo bots keep working if my phone goes offline?
faq.a: Yes. Each bot operates in its own dedicated cloud environment that runs 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, executing scheduled routines and autonomous workflows completely independently of your phone or internet connection.

faq.q: How does Ceyo integrate with Telegram?
faq.a: You can assign agents as individual Telegram assistants or bring multiple specialized bots into group chats, allowing them to collaborate with each other and your team on research, coding, and workflow automation.

faq.q: What languages can Ceyo agents understand and write?
faq.a: Ceyo agents process and communicate seamlessly in standard English and can interpret queries or context in widely spoken regional languages like Bemba and Nyanja, alongside dozens of international languages.

faq.q: How secure is my business data and documents?
faq.a: Each bot operates inside a strictly isolated cloud computer with isolated memory, persistent documents, and secure encrypted access to connected applications and crypto wallets.
